# Daily Briefing – Wednesday 12 August

Yesterday was a light day — no training logged and just 6,088 steps, though your body still burned 2,390 kcal, sitting nicely above your 2,300 target. The main flag is sleep: 5.6 hours isn't enough to support your weight loss and training goals, and that's worth taking seriously.

The good news is your recovery markers look solid. HRV at 103ms sits within your 100–118ms baseline, and a resting HR of 47bpm is excellent. Stress at 38/100 is calm. Your body is ready — go ahead with today's planned session as normal, no modifications needed.

The one thing to prioritise today: get to bed earlier tonight. Poor sleep blunts fat metabolism and increases muscle breakdown — both work directly against your 80–85kg target. Aim for 7.5 hours. Hit your 175g protein too; it'll help protect muscle on this weight-loss phase. You've got 88 days — let's build good habits now. 💪
